description: a slim celestial knight of ordinary size, not broad, a man with warm brown skin, short dark hair, a stern scarred face, eyes burning with white fire, slim plate armour of polished silver and pale gold with glowing white runes, a long white cloak hanging behind from the shoulders, a few small white and ice-blue holy flames close around the head, silver greaves and boots, no sword and nothing in the hands, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing and walking to the right, the nose pointing right and only one eye showing, the chest, belly and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near arm showing, hanging relaxed beside the body with an empty loosely closed hand, the far arm hidden behind the body, the back and shoulders straight and upright, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head and its flames to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the same character seen from the side: face, hair, armour, cloak, holy glow, colours and drawing style; not the sitting pose and not the hands on the reins: he stands and walks
the character's look in detail: face, hair, armour, cloak, holy glow and colours; the hands empty, without the sword
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen exactly from the side in profile, facing right, upright mid-step, not turned towards the viewer; copy it exactly
